why_points: The pick: Carries lower 16.5 on Underdog. Each pick has to win 56% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (draftkings 13.5, moved to this line) is 69%.
Other apps: PrizePicks 13.5. This is the best number for the lower side.
Game log, most recent first: 8, 18, 21, 15, 20, 23, 24, 19. Weighted average 17.1; went lower than 16.5 in 2 of 8 games (34% recency-weighted).
Trending down: last 3 games average 15.7 vs 20.2 in the games before.
How much he swings: game to game he typically moves about ±5.3, so the line is 0.1 of those swings below his average (standard deviations) — basically a coin flip.
Projection: we expect 14.3 carries on average; in a typical game 13.7 (a few big games pull the average up, so the typical game is what we compare with the line) — 2.8 below the line.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 47% and the matchup 61%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 67%, matchup 68%.
Bottom line: we give it 68% to win and it needs 56%. The edge is the difference: +12.2 points; that works out to about +22¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
